name: cert-prep
title: Certification exam prep
description: One exam domain per episode: concepts, the service mapping, the traps, and spoken recall drills.
authoring_brief: Certification exams test discrimination, not recall of definitions — the candidate has to pick between four plausible services. So every concept must land as 'use X when Y, not Z because W'. State the domain weight up front so effort can be allocated. Never read a service list; always pair a service with the job it does and the service it is most often confused with. Say percentages and numbers in words. Never write AI slash ML — say 'AI and ML'. Keep episodes dense rather than long: six to twelve minutes of discrimination practice beats sixteen minutes padded with definitions.
